facts_only_in_summary.config_realized_by_worker: the per-worker REALIZED cp map. summary mode cross-checks it against config_requested (cp_map.realized_workers_cross_checked says how many workers); a manifest is written before the first worker starts, so here that cross-check covers ZERO workers and the requested map is taken on trust
facts_only_in_summary.rows / games: the corpus totals. The progress inventory's own per-shard row counts stand in (corpus_record_detail.rows_claimed_by_inventory), and they count CLOSED shards only
facts_only_in_summary.search / dedup / terminations / opening_: per-run counters accumulated in memory and written once at the end. Not read by this tool, and not reconstructible from the shards

input.why_zero_history: row schema 1: a row is a bare FEN, chess.Board(fen) has an empty move stack, and the encoder fills history slot 0 only -- slots 1..7 (planes 13..103) and every repetition plane stay ZERO. Row schema 2 banks history_root_fen + history_uci and board_from_row replays them, so the 8 frames are the frames live play encodes; see row_schema_counts and history_slots_filled_histogram for which this run derived

policy.construction: softmax(q / temp) over the scheme's values

required_training_overrides.search_wdl_frac: the whole non-outcome share. These shards carry no sf_wdl, so losses.py would redirect any SF share onto the raw game outcome; the searched value is in search_wdl

row_flags.is_network_turn: true — no network played these plies; set so the rows are not dropped by the train-on-network-turns filter
row_flags.is_selfplay: true — Stockfish against itself, no curriculum arm
row_flags.priority: 1.0 — no surprise weighting exists for a corpus row

row_provenance.identity: source directory/config, raw shard and physical row; original and stored history input keys

seed_effect: permutes rows WITHIN each shard; changes no target value

source_selection.order: original corpus shard order; limit applies after selection

value_blend.note: the row carries the two components; the mixing weights are the trainer's, exactly as on data/lc0_rows

value_channels.categorical_target: ABSENT — outcome-derived, and wdl_target carries the outcome
value_channels.moves_left: ABSENT — a corpus row does not know its game's length
value_channels.search_wdl: cp_to_wdl_array of the best-move value from latest-phase observation at depth 9: Stockfish's searched root value, side-to-move POV. ⚑ NOT our MCTS's value, which is what this column means on production shards
value_channels.sf_wdl: ABSENT — deliberately. lc0_control_train.py's launch guard 1 (assert_pid_cannot_reassert_sf_wdl) refuses any config with sf_wdl_frac > 0 regardless of what the shards carry, so a value written here could never reach a loss on this rig
value_channels.wdl_target: the corpus row's exact game result, already stored from that row's own side-to-move seat (result_from_pov). 0=W/1=D/2=L

value_scheme.construction: Q_t — the searched root value, unchanged (V0)
value_scheme.frozen_by: docs/experiment_ledger.md — 2026-08-31 PREREG VALUE-TARGET ROUND and its two same-day amendments
value_scheme.name: search
value_scheme.q_definition: cp_to_wdl_array of the best-move latest-phase observation at depth 9; the policy observation is selected independently
value_scheme.z_definition: one-hot of the row's own `result`, which result_from_pov already stored in that row's seat — never rotated again
